title: Fresh task job-result acceptance screen
hypothesis: Compact job metadata preserves failure recovery, overlapping-job completion and independent edits without material time or cost regression on fresh tasks.
falsified_if: Activation fails, either arm fails artifact or completion verification, or compact results regress latency or estimated cost beyond the registered tolerance.
local_evidence: Follow-up to research/decisions/2026-09-17-job-results-screen.md and original log calls 26:5/7/8/10. The previous synthetic formatter screen passed; this comparison uses real command options and no inserted padding. Offline acceptance checks separately cover restart, legacy recovery, large cursor drains, isolation and process death.
deterministic_outcomes: successful durable verification of final artifact
decision_rule: Seed 918, six screen cells (one per arm and scenario), randomized adjacent pairs after the simple control pair. Model GPT-6 Astra/high and all execution, cursors, deadlines, schemas and prompts are identical across arms; only command rendering differs. No synthetic command expansion in either fresh task. Freeze source/fixtures/graders before launch; validate positive/negative graders and serialized result formatting. Maximum six launches, $3 standard-equivalent between-run cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 420 active seconds. Stop on artifact/protocol/activation failure, preserve evidence, fix defects and register any rerun separately. Correctness gate: all tasks pass independent artifacts, required observed terminal output, protected scope and no abandoned jobs. Efficiency gate: aggregate coding time and estimated cost no more than 20% worse and neither task more than 35% worse. Report per-task model/tool calls, tokens/cache and costs alongside artifacts; simple-control spend included but simple timing excluded from coding gate. A positive screen supports fresh validation only; it cannot establish general efficiency adoption. Deterministic acceptance and clean-install results are reported separately. No notification architecture is introduced.
